findings.message: `pagefront:reviewIncentive` on review `https://merchant.example/reviews/r-88102` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][2]['pagefront:reviewIncentive']` is `gift`, which is not one of `none`, `discount`, `free_product`, `sample_program`, `undisclosed`.
findings.remediation: Declare `pagefront:reviewIncentive` on every review as `none`, `discount`, `free_product`, `sample_program` or `undisclosed`; a publisher that does not know writes `undisclosed`, never nothing.
